in_marathi.name: Viju
in_marathi.long_meaning: Viju हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Viju is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vijaya', which means 'victorious' or 'conqueror'. It is also associated with the god Vishnu, symbolizing joy and light.
